title: ipomoea vitifolia var. angularis
intro: Ipomoea vitifolia var. angularis, commonly known as the "bitter morning glory," is a plant species in the Ipomoea genus. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Ipomoea vitifolia var. angularis include its ability to act as a gastrointestinal protectant, antispasmodic, and anti-ulcerogenic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
